name: mp4ff-bounded-parameter-set-decoding
instr:
mp4ff cannot put one finite resource budget around nested decoding of untrusted bitstreams, codec parameter sets, and MP4 files. Add a `DecodeBudget` from `github.com/Eyevinn/mp4ff/bits` that is monotonic across child operations, exposes remaining allowances through `Snapshot`, and identifies the first exhausted resource with `BudgetError`.

Make `Reader`, `EBSPReader`, and fixed-slice operations charge actual work, including EBSP prevention bytes. Overlong variable codes must stop with `BudgetError`; excessive lengths or allocations must fail before returning partial payloads.

VPS fields, layer sets, timing, HRD, extensions, SPS, and profile-tier-level syntax must share one allowance. Conditional sublayers charge their flags and level syntax, but omitted profiles charge no collections. Preserve valid structures. AVC HRD and HEVC sublayer HRD must charge their distinct CPB and conditional-field shapes through the same contract.

The bits package provides `NewDecodeBudget`, `NewReaderWithBudget`, `NewEBSPReaderWithBudget`, and `NewFixedSliceReaderWithBudget`; the HEVC package provides `ParseVPSNALUnitWithBudget`, `ParseSPSNALUnitWithBudget`, and `DecodeHEVCDecConfRecWithBudget`; the AVC package provides `ParseSPSNALUnitWithBudget`; and the MP4 package provides `WithDecodeBudget`.

Charge hvcC array counts, NAL lengths, stored bytes, and nested parameter parsing to one allowance. Both DecodeFile engines must apply it to headers, ordered boxes, hvcC records, and embedded parame
